openQuestions: Do margins of about 55%+ hold in the second half?
Does rising capex (contracted Rs 16.9bn, committed Rs 24.6bn) eat into free cash flow and dividends?
Were the Rs 0.5bn exchange gain and the cost savings one-offs?
Is a dividend of Rs 3+ a year sustained?
Any new telecom levies, VAT changes or spectrum costs?
